name: Innkeeper Allison
summary: In Stormwind's Trade District, Innkeeper Allison keeps the Gilded Rose ready for travelers and merchants. The busy inn stands between the bank and auction house, where she offers hearthstone bindings, drinks, and shelter.

sections.title: Hospitality in the Trade District
sections.body: Innkeeper Allison welcomes travelers at the Gilded Rose in Stormwind. The inn stands between the Trade District auction house and the city's main vaults, and its ground floor sees a steady flow of peddlers, mercenaries, and visiting diplomats. She keeps order behind the main counter and offers lodging and hearthstone services. Allison also joins local holiday festivities and coordinates small errands for traveling heroes seeking rest in the capital.

faq.q: Where can I find Innkeeper Allison?
faq.answer: Innkeeper Allison stands behind the counter on the ground floor of the Gilded Rose. The inn is in Stormwind City's Trade District, between the central bank and the auction house.

faq.q: What services does Innkeeper Allison offer?
faq.answer: Innkeeper Allison lets travelers bind their hearthstones to the Gilded Rose and offers food and drink. She also takes part in seasonal events and holidays.

faq.q: Does Innkeeper Allison offer any quests?
faq.answer: Yes. Innkeeper Allison takes part in seasonal festivities and can sometimes help with city errands for travelers seeking aid across the realm.

angles.text: As an Alliance champion, you can rest at the Gilded Rose after returning from the front lines and bank your spoils there.
